description: Approved (skill × scenario × run_type × executor) combinations for the W1 pilot evaluation.
seed_temperature_policy: Desktop threads do not expose seed or temperature controls. Packets record requested_seed and requested_temperature for intent; observed_seed and observed_temperature are always null. Isolation is achieved via fresh isolated threads and explicit run-angle prompts in system_prompt.

external_output_policy.description: Raw model output files are written by external gpt-5.6-terra desktop threads. All raw artifacts go to .omx/evidence/tastecheck-v1/raw/<skill>/<scenario_id>/ exclusively. The evals/ tree contains only authored schemas, config, job packets, and sanitized receipts.
